title: Camera Moves & Transitions
description: A lighthouse keeper and a fishing boat: every camera move preset on the same four seconds, custom-key showcases, and shot pairs that craft whip, match, action and wipe transitions.

environment.description: A rocky headland in a sheltered bay on a bright breezy morning: a white lighthouse with a red cap, a small stone cottage, a high stone pier, a rock arch in the sea and green hills around the bay
environment.style: Photoreal coastal film. Clear morning sun, deep blue water with gentle swell, crisp natural colour. No logos, brand names, badges, signage or lettering anywhere

entities.name: Bay hills
entities.notes: Green hills and pale cliffs ringing the bay

entities.name: Sea 1
entities.notes: Calm deep blue-green sea with a gentle swell

entities.name: Headland
entities.notes: A blunt granite headland with weathered grey cliffs

entities.name: Headland grass
entities.notes: Short wind-flattened grass on the clifftop

entities.name: Cliff rock 1
entities.notes: Dark wet granite boulders at the waterline

entities.name: Arch top
entities.notes: A natural sea arch of dark granite

entities.name: Lighthouse
entities.notes: A tall white-painted round stone lighthouse tower

entities.name: Gallery
entities.notes: A black iron gallery with a railing

entities.name: Lantern
entities.notes: The round glass lantern room of the lighthouse, a bright lamp glowing behind the panes

entities.name: Lighthouse door
entities.notes: A heavy painted blue wooden door with iron hinges

entities.name: Cottage
entities.notes: A small whitewashed stone cottage with a slate roof

entities.name: Fishing boat
entities.notes: A small wooden fishing boat with a red hull, a white wheelhouse and a short mast; no name, numbers or lettering

entities.name: Keeper
entities.notes: A lighthouse keeper in a navy wool sweater, dark oilskin trousers, black rubber boots and a grey knit cap; weathered face, short grey beard
entities.styleNotes: Plain workwear without logos or lettering

shots.title: Whip pan A · out
shots.description: @keeper spots @fishing-boat out in the bay and waves an arm high in greeting.

shots.title: Whip pan B · in
shots.description: @fishing-boat motors slowly across the bay toward the headland, a low wake curling behind it.

shots.title: Match cut A · lantern
shots.description: @lantern glows behind its panes at the top of the tower; gulls wheel past the gallery.

shots.title: Match cut B · buoy
shots.description: @buoy rides the swell while @fishing-boat passes beyond it, heading in toward the headland.

shots.title: Cut on action A · wide
shots.description: @keeper walks up the gravel path to the lighthouse and hauls open @lighthouse-door.

shots.title: Cut on action B · close
shots.description: @lighthouse-door swings wide and @keeper steps through the dark doorway into the tower.

shots.title: Wipe A · foreground rock
shots.description: @fishing-boat glides in toward the stone pier, slowing as it nears the cliff.

shots.title: Wipe B · reveal
shots.description: @fishing-boat comes to rest alongside the stone pier below the lighthouse, rocking gently.
